messages:
maya: bringing nova-q4f into the eval harness; quick repro with chat task and batch=8 failing with kv-cache/seq_len assert
ravi: paste the runner log when you have it
maya: here's the excerpt from staging-runner (trimmed):
```
2025-10-12T09:14:02Z ERROR runner.batch: seq_len mismatch: expected=1024 got=1023
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/eval/runner/worker.py", line 312, in _process_batch
    out = model.generate_batch(batch_inputs)
  File "/opt/models/nova/q4f/inference.py", line 196, in generate_batch
    assert kv_cache_len == req_seq_len, f"kv cache len {kv_cache_len} != {req_seq_len}"
AssertionError: kv cache len 1023 != 1024
```
sophie: that smells like special-token length differences between tokenizer builds. did q4f export change special token encodings?
dina: we saw q4f artifacts set pad_token_id to -1 during export in earlier runs
maya: current model config copy in eval repo:
```
model: nova-7b
build: q4f-20251010
pad_token_id: -1
chat_template: system_first_compact
batch_size: 8
max_seq_len: 1024
```
ravi: collate_fn should reject pad_token_id < 0. otherwise padding and attention masks get scrambled when stacking tensors
maya: locally i changed collate to raise a clear error and the failing run now errors earlier with "negative pad token" — good for debugging
sophie: also check token mappings: some chat templates insert <SYSTEM> and <USER> tokens which, in one tokenizer.json, map to multi-id ligatures (e.g. [50270,2]) after quantization
maya: i diffed q4f tokenizer.json vs fp16: "<SYSTEM>" maps to 50270 (fp16) vs [50270,2] (q4f). that would change lengths
dina: workaround: set pad_token_id=0 at load; that lets batching continue but changes tokenization boundaries, so eval scores shift
maya: observed BLEU -0.4 and ROUGE-L -0.2 after pad hack in a smoke run
ravi: that's risky for comparisons. we need canonical tokenizer mapping recorded in eval metadata and ideally normalize q4f tokenizer to single-id special tokens
sophie: propose: (1) collate assert for pad>=0 with helpful msg; (2) tokenizer-normalize step in quant builder that maps special tokens to fp16 canonical ids when present; (3) add tokenizer_sha + quant_id to eval output for traceability
maya: i'll open a PR for collate assert + unit tests that synthesize chat templates with multi-id specials
dina: i'll run overnight nightly with pad workaround to keep scheduled reports flowing and compare metric diffs
ci-bot: [CI] eval-harness/pr-214 failed 1 check (collate-asserts missing). logs: https://ci.redwood/eval/214
ravi: sophie, can you own the quant-builder normalization RFC? prefer to preserve canonical mapping used by authoring team
sophie: yep i'll draft RFC and include a compatibility test that compares tokenized lengths for common chat templates
maya: pushed quickfix branch collate-asserts, attaching unit that reproduces the bug. PR link: https://stash.redwood/eng-ml/patches/123
dina: FYI i also uploaded a tiny repro harness under eng-ml/scratch/nova-q4f-repro.git
maya: marking this thread as tracked bug eval-chat::nova-q4f-kv-mismatch
ravi: next steps: land collate PR, run quant-normalization RFC, regenerate q4f artifact if needed, re-run nightly and evaluate metric drift
maya: assigning: maya=collate PR, sophie=quant RFC, dina=overnight run. tagging @ravi for release guidance :eyes:
ravi: ack, will monitor metric deltas. ping if drift >0.5 BLEU
maya: thanks all, will follow up in this thread when CI green and nightly completes
